name: Wasurenagusa
storyline:
The protagonist, Sora, was working odd jobs after graduating from university with no particular purpose. One day, Sora receives a notice about a class reunion. It had been over ten years since graduation. The notice had no sender's name. He figured it was probably the work of someone like Kaito, who was the ringleader of the kids, so he decided not to pry into who the sender was.

Sora's hometown was a village on the verge of becoming a ghost town, and it had a small branch school. Before Sora graduated, the branch school was closed, and the village itself was to be merged with a neighboring village. The village children were all scheduled to attend the school in the neighboring village, but Sora was the only one who had to leave the village due to his parents' work. He hasn't returned to the village since then. According to the letter, the village is going to be redeveloped, and the branch school will be demolished. That's why the sender wants to hold a reunion with the last students at the branch school, a place full of memories.

Sora travels to his hometown, albeit for a class reunion, as a way to escape reality. With several days to go before the reunion, he stays at the house where his deceased grandfather used to live. After reuniting with his old friends, Sora and Sena, who harbors feelings for him, go on a picnic to the charcoal burner's hut where they used to play as children. It was a secret place just for the two of them. Over a decade ago, on the day Sora left the village, he had promised to meet Sena there. However, Sora left without fulfilling that promise. Sena, it turns out, had been waiting ever since... Sealed memories and human emotions begin to encroach upon reality...
